ceo_directive: The PatSnap lesson becomes a permanent regression test: never classify API failure from unvalidated request schema

the_bug.what_happened: V3.1 used wrong request schema ({q:{expression:...}}) for PatSnap P075, got 68300004 (Invalid parameter), and incorrectly classified it as TIER_RESTRICTED
the_bug.root_cause: Guessed the failure reason instead of validating the schema first
the_bug.correct_sequence: FETCH DOCUMENTATION → VALIDATE REQUEST SCHEMA → EXECUTE → INTERPRET ERROR CODE → CLASSIFY FAILURE

test_rules: If parameter_validity=INVALID, classification MUST be PARAMETER_ERROR (not TIER_RESTRICTED)
If classification=BALANCE_EXHAUSTED, parameter_validity MUST be VALID (you can only know balance is exhausted if schema was correct)
TIER_RESTRICTED is not a valid classification — the documented permission error is 67200004, which requires primary evidence
applies_to: All 150 inventions — this is bigger than CereVasc
